surprises: Roles changed outside every recorded script: the default User role (RoEK3_3NtdWL) and the spike roles A/B (RoEKHLFdFsUJ, RoEKHLGDsV2J) no longer exist, and the default Admin role is now "Admin / Developer". Window: after the generate read-back on 8 Oct (~19:00 UTC, 0 fails incl. "Admin/User exist") and before 9 Oct 06:56 UTC (first log line naming "Admin / Developer"). The 4 spike flows were touched by Flobot on 9 Oct 06:39:22 UTC, which fits a role deletion then [inference].

Test harness is orphaned but still wired: CIQ ZZ Spike Case: 10 step owner(s) point at deleted roles, 0 flow members; CIQ ZZ Spike Point: 2 step owner(s) point at deleted roles, 0 flow members. Both spike integrations are still ON and were re-published by Flobot today (2026-10-14T06:52:22Z, 2026-10-14T06:52:24Z).

The app was published today, 2026-10-14T06:52:29Z by Thomas; no request log in the project records any write since 9 Oct, so this was done outside the scripts (UI) [inference]. Nothing designed changed: every CIQ flow's LastPublishedAt is still 8 Oct (Open Point 18:59:51 = the send-back switch). The /explore listing shows the portal was published a few seconds later (06:52:39).
The 11 D38 role renames are NOT applied; live names are still the rev-31 "CIQ …" names. The 3 D38 roles exist with CIQ Reader's grants.

Delete on the audit trail: 10 roles hold Member ["Delete"] on CIQ Audit Event (CIQ RMM, CIQ Regulatory Reviewer, CIQ Safety Reviewer, CIQ QM Reviewer, CIQ Microbiology Reviewer, CIQ Sustainability Reviewer, CIQ Overall Approver, CIQ Business Admin, CIQ Case Admin, CIQ Integration Service). This is what the plan compiles (form write = Member [Delete]); the post-generate no-Delete reset (K-17) was never done. Internal Note: 13 roles with Delete, incl. CIQ Reader and the 3 D38 roles.

No SLA, reminder or step e-mail settings exist on any process (no such keys in the drafts); process fields carry no field-level Required (all requiredness is step Mandatory, which the API key does not enforce, D33).
Only one Reference field exists in the app: RMES Safety/Regulatory.Result_Case → CIQ_Case_A00 (lookup Case_Code). Every other cross-record link is a Text id (Case_Code, *_Item_Id).

The live process is still the pre-call v4 design (Scope check, Overall approval, the two open-items checks, Overall_Decision gate on PS-11); the 9 Oct client decisions are not in the app yet (see STATUS-2026-10-14.md §2).

Record inconsistencies: decisions.md D37 names the bundle ciq-workbench-ui-244b9bd7db.zip, but live (and deploy-report.json) is ciq-workbench-ui-235af550b4.zip. STATUS-2026-10-14.md counts CIQ Case at 123 fields and "16" live roles; live is 125 header fields (draft = published runtime list) and 15 roles. postgen/readback-result.json and postgen/live/ were overwritten today 15:53 UTC by the app session's read-back, so the 9 Oct draft baseline is gone; this inventory therefore compares against the plan (rev 31 + preview), not against 9 Oct drafts.
